title: She kept ramming Diego Loveless's car while he was stuck on the phone
description: Diego was stuck on a call in GTA 6 while an NPC kept ramming his car. He could only watch... until he hung up.
hook_text:
SHE KEPT HITTING HIS CAR
WHILE HE WAS ON THE PHONE
first_comment: How long would YOU have stayed on that call? 📞
